task_summary: Created a separate Chapter 4 Google Doc draft organized by the supplied 100-point rubric, using the supplied manuscript and survey records while excluding illustrative technical benchmarks from measured results.
key_decisions: Follow the supplied six-category Chapter 4 rubric and five study objectives.
Report only the 71 complete student survey records as measured user-evaluation results.
Treat technical benchmark figures as illustrative and describe listed test scenarios as procedures because per-case outcomes were not recorded.
Leave the source manuscript and survey unchanged.
lessons_learned: Lesson learned: a list of test scenarios and sample benchmark values cannot support pass-rate or accuracy claims. Prevention runbook/checklist: verify outcome logs, conditions, sample labels and calculations before writing technical conclusions; disclose missing evidence in the results chapter.
open_threads: Authors should add documented per-case functional outcomes and reproducible technical benchmark evidence if available; no estimates were invented in this draft.
